content.title: Korea Slaps Hefty Fine on SK Telecom for Years of Negligence
content.summary: The Personal Information Protection Commission on Thursday fined SK Telecom Co. 134.8 billion won ($97 million) for failing to protect customer data and not reporting breaches in a timely manner.  “The company had been in a vulnerable state for quite a long time, with significant weaknesses across the board,” said PIPC Chairman Ko Haksoo.  PIPC’s decision and commentary adds to pressure on the telecom to reform its practices.
